$comment: Touring-car contact: a DTM car shrugs off a tap that would break an F1 front wing, and a damaged front end is driven home rather than swapped at a stop. Lap-one pile-ups never break the front wing (the game would swap it at the next stop), and contact damages parts half as much as vanilla. How the game repairs damage at a stop is not data (wishlist D6).

punctures.$comment: Game 0.99.6+. Off in vanilla. The game's default rates (about 1 to 3 per season across the grid); a DTM car leans hard on its tyres and runs wheel-to-wheel, so contact punctures are a little likelier than in F1.

pitstops.$comment: Game 0.99.6+: team-mates share one pit crew, and a second car queues. Kept on (the game's default): later DTM rules banned team-mates from double-stacking under the safety car, which only matters with a shared crew. Not confirmed for 2013.
